en.quote: …raise the total fertility rate to 1.753 by 2018.
en.head: The 2018 fertility rate was 1.579.
en.body: Rosstat recorded a total fertility rate of 1.579 children per woman in 2018. The decree’s target for that year was 1.753. Later figures are unnecessary to assess the original deadline.
en.meta_context: Decree No. 606, “On Measures to Implement the Demographic Policy of the Russian Federation”

osrc.t: Rosstat, total fertility rate in Russia
